internal_collaboration.evidence_quote: Welcome to Goddess Kouture, where fashion meets confidence and every woman is encouraged to step into her goddess era.Founded by A’lexus, a proud New Orleans, Louisiana native, Goddess Kouture was created from a passion for fashion and a desire to help women feel beautiful, confident, and empowered at an affordable price. What began as a dream has grown into a brand built on the belief that every woman deserves to feel like the best version of herself.

network.coverage_note: Goddess Kouture is a commercial fashion boutique and not an educational institution; therefore, it has no Erasmus+ partners or international mobility programs.
